title: Systems & Automation Specialist (No-Code Workflows)
description:
**Part-time. Remote. Clay, Notion, reporting, and automations.**



---



## The short version



I run a small agency. There's a lot going on behind the client work. Lead lists, outreach, reporting, internal tools, automations. I build most of it myself right now. I've got to the point where I need someone to own it.



This is not an admin or VA role. I need someone who thinks in systems. You look at a process and work it out. When this happens here, that should happen there. And it stays clean while it does.



Do you like taking a messy workflow and making it simple? Then this is a good fit.



---



## What the role is



Most of the work is "if this, then that" logic across tools. You also keep the data behind it clean.



A lot of it looks like this. We take raw data. We run it through a chain of checks and steps. We clean it as it goes. Then we send each record to the right place on its own. That's one system. There are more like it. There's the Notion side too, which keeps the work in order. And the reporting side, which keeps the numbers honest.



Here's the key part. This is a build role, not a run role. I've got people who run the day to day. The reports, the outreach, the uploads. What I'm missing is someone who owns the systems under all of that. You design them. You automate them. You fix them when they break. You make them simpler so the team moves faster. You build the machine. You don't turn the handle on it each day.



You don't need to know every tool I use. You need to be the type who can open a new one and work out the logic. That counts more than any tool on your CV.



---



## What you'd be doing



The work splits into a few areas. You won't own all of it on day one. But this is the shape of it.



**The outreach system**

- Own the setup in Clay. That's the logic that finds the right people. It adds company data, writes custom lines, then routes each record to the right place.

- Build the checks that keep the data clean. No repeats. No wasted credits.

- Set up the exports. Records should flow into our outreach tools on their own.

- Build the systems behind our shared inbox.



**Notion**

- Build and look after the databases. Clients, briefs, creative, creators, payments.

- Set up the automations, views, and templates. The team then works from one clean system.

- Move data in cleanly. Keep the naming the same throughout.



**Reporting and data**

- Build the pipelines so the numbers pull in clean. Spend, revenue, MER, aMER, and margin. They come fro
ta, Google, and Shopify.

- Look after the Looker Studio dashboards. And the connectors that feed them, like Windsor.ai or Supermetrics.

- Automate the manual steps. No one should redo them by hand each week. The weekly Slack digest is one.



**Automation across tools**

- Build the "if this, then that" logic across Clay, Notion, Sheets, Slack, and the outreach tools. Use Zapier or Make.

- Link the tools so data moves clean. And nothing gets typed in twice.



**Keep it simple and clear**

- Write short guides so each process can be re-done. It shouldn't live in one head.

- Test things well before they go live.

- Spot when a system is too big. Then make it smaller.



---



## The kind of person I want



- You think in systems, not tasks.

- You're at ease in tools you've never used.

- You like the logic problem, not just the clicks.

- You spot repeats, gaps, and mess that others miss.

- You'd rather make a thing simpler than bigger.

- You can explain how a system works in plain words.

- You test before you trust.



Read the example up top. Did you think "what's the key, where's the dedupe, how many tables is this"? Then you're the right type.



---



## Tools you'd work in



You don't need all of these on day one. But this is the world you'd work in.



- Clay, for lead data and routing

- Notion, for databases and guides

- Zapier or Make, for automation

- Google Sheets and Looker Studio, for reporting. Plus a connector like Windsor.ai or Supermetrics.

- Shopify, Meta, and Google Ads, to pull data. Not to buy media.



Strong logic and the will to learn beat deep skill in one tool.



---



## The details



- **Hours:** Starts part-time. Around 10 to 20 hours a week. There's more here than that, so there's real room to grow.

- **Where:** Remote. I work with people across time zones. Where you are isn't the issue. Being reliable and clear is.

- **Pay:** $5 an hour, based on skill. Or we agree a fixed price to build the core systems first.



---



## How to apply



Don't send a long cover letter. Send me this.



1. A short note on a system you built or fixed. And what made it work.

2. One tool you'd never used, picked up, and got good with.

3. Your answer to this. The same company shows up as five rows in my list. How would you stop that?



Keep it plain and simple. If you can think clear on that last one, we should talk.

description:
Experienced CS Agent — High-Volume Dropshipping (A-Players Only)



We're not hiring someone to close tickets and clock out. We're hiring a killer CS agent who treats our support operation like it's their own business. If you read job posts looking for "tasks" and "responsibilities" to tick off — close this one. If you read them looking for an operation you can take ownership of and grow inside of, keep reading.



We run a 6–7 figure multi-brand e-commerce operation spanning 5 stores across the EU and US markets. We move fast, we scale hard, and we're building a backend team that runs like a machine. You'll join a backend team of 7 and work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Supply Chain Manager, Backend Manager, Dispute Manager, and CS team.

This is a CS Agent role : high-ownership one. You'll be on the frontline of our support operation across all stores. (Got management experience? Even better : there's real room to grow here if your performance is good for 2 months. But make no mistake: this role is about being an elite agent first.)



This is not a "follow the SOP and wait for instructions" role. This is a "I saw a problem three steps before anyone asked, and I fixed it" role.



The single most important thing we're looking for

Ownership. You don't just clear your queue — you look beyond your own lane, spot problems early (refunds, fulfillment delays, chargebacks, disputes), and get ahead of them. Proactivity and work ethic rank above everything else. Show us that, and you get paid extremely well for it.



What you'll own

Customer service across all stores, at high volume, without dropping quality

Keeping tickets moving fast and flagging backend issues before they blow up

Staying tightly synced with supply chain and disputes so nothing falls through the cracks

Helping improve the systems that make the whole operation run smoother every week



Requirements (read carefully)



Minimum 3 years of CS experience in dropshipping — non-negotiable

You can handle a minimum of 20 tickets per hour. If you can't, don't apply.

Strong hands-on experience with Gorgias

You understand high-scale dropshipping — the volume, the margins, the chaos.

Strong experience with Claude / AI tools — this is core to how we operate; you need to be genuinely good with it

A relentless work ethic and an ownership-first mindset

Excellent written English and clear, fast communication



What you get



Well-paid base — we pay A-players like A-players

High KPI-based bonuses on top — your performance directly drives your income

A genuine chance to grow inside a scaling 6–7 figure business — the ceiling is high

A sharp, fast-moving backend team that takes the work seriously



Start date: Immediate. We're ready to move now and we want someone who's ready too.

How to apply



Don't send a generic application — show us how you take ownership.



Start your letter with the word OWNERSHIP. Applications that don't will not be considered.

title: HQCHEER — JOB OPENING
description:
|  Posted June 2026

UI/UX Designer & Webflow Developer

with Cheerleading Industry Experience — Creative Lead





Role Type · Compensation · Location · Time Zone

  Part-Time to Full-Time (20–40 hrs/wk)  

  Remote · Anywhere  

  Hourly — Competitive · Commensurate with Experience  

  Preferred: Overlap with US Central Time (CST)  







About HQCheer

HQCheer (
) is a comprehensive digital training platform for the cheerleading industry — built for athletes, coaches, and gym owners. We host 300+ skill videos across 8 progression levels (Basics, Level 1–7) and 5 skill categories (Tumbling, Stunts, Baskets, Jumps, Pyramids), with video review coaching, progress tracking, team management, and a community for the entire cheer ecosystem.

Our lead reviewer is a 6× World Champion coach with 21+ years of experience across four continents. We support both All-Star and Scholastic programs.

We are a lean, fast-moving team. The platform is live and in active development. You will be stepping into a Creative Lead role with real ownership and real impact.



The Role

We are looking for a UI/UX Designer and Webflow Developer who also has firsthand experience in cheerleading — as an athlete, coach, former coach, gym owner, or cheer parent. This is not a nice-to-have. It is a requirement. We are building for a niche community and the person who designs for it needs to understand it from the inside.



As Creative Lead, you will:

Own design direction for every page and component before it goes to our developer

Produce screen designs, layout specs, and annotated handoffs that our Webflow developer can build directly from

QA every build against your design intent — you approve before anything ships

Collaborate with the CEO and co-founders on product decisions, user flows, and new feature UX

Maintain visual consistency across 18 dashboard screens, public pages, and mobile views

Understand the cheerleading world well enough to design for it — skill levels, athlete/coach/gym-owner differences, what matters to this community



What You Are Building

The platform is built in Webflow with Memberstack 2.0 for access gating, Airtable for relational data, Stripe for payments, and Make.com for automation. Our v4 design reference covers 18 screens:

Athlete, Parent, Coach, Gym Owner, and Pro Expert dashboards

Video Library with category + level filtering

Video Review submission flow ($20 athlete / $25 coach pay-per-review via Stripe)

Live Calls and Webinar pages

Coach Glossary, Manage Coaches, Teams (Scholastic/All-Star toggle)

Gym Billing, Parent My Children (circular skill rings), Parent Billing

Review Queue with SLA tracking, Gym Settings, Account Settings

Dark mode aesthetic. Brand purple #8B5CF6 gradient. Fonts: Aleo (headings), Outfit (body), Ubuntu (accents). This is a specific, locked visual system — you are refining and extending it, not reinventing it.



Requirements

Non-Negotiable

Cheerleading experience — athlete, coach, gym owner, or cheer parent. You must understand this world from the inside.

Proven UI/UX design portfolio with dark mode or sports/fitness platform work preferred

Webflow proficiency — you can build in Webflow, not just design for it

Reliable, consistent communication — daily updates, same-day blocker flags, no ghosting

Ability to hit deadlines. We work on two-week delivery cycles. Late is not acceptable.

Availability of 20–40 hours per week with some US Central Time overlap



Strongly Preferred

Experience designing membership platforms, gated content, or subscription-based apps

Familiarity with Memberstack, Airtable, or Make.com

Experience with dashboard design — complex role-based UIs with multiple user types

Mobile-first or responsive design experience

Ability to produce Loom walkthroughs or annotated spec docs for developer handoff



What We Offer

Real Creative Lead ownership — not spec execution, but design leadership

Long-term growth path for the right person — we build with people, not just hire them

Flexible remote work with async-first communication

A platform that is already live, already growing, and already matters in the cheer community

Direct collaboration with the founder team — no middle layers, no committees



What This Is Not

This is not a freelance design gig where you hand off mockups and disappear.

This is not a role for someone who needs hand-holding on technical decisions.

This is not suitable if you cannot commit to consistent weekly hours right now.

Cheerleading experience is not optional. We will not consider applications without it.







How to Apply

Send the following to 
 with subject line: Creative Lead Application — [Your Name]



Your portfolio or 2–3 relevant work samples (links preferred)

A brief description of your cheerleading background — were you an athlete? A coach? For how long? What level?

Your Webflow experience — what have you built? Link to examples if available.

Your availability and time zone

Your hourly rate expectation



Applications without a cheerleading background described will not be reviewed. Please do not apply if you do not have direct experience in the sport.

title: Senior Dispute manager Dropshipping
description:
Senior Dispute Manager (Ecommerce / Dropshipping)



We're a fast-growing ecommerce group running multiple dropshipping stores across several international markets — and we're scaling fast. As we grow, so does the volume of disputes, chargebacks, and pre-arbitration cases. That's where you come in.



We're looking for a Senior Dispute Manager who lives and breathes payment disputes, knows exactly how to win them (and prevent them), and can fully own this role from day one.

This role is for an A-player who takes ownership — not someone we need to micromanage.



You should be able to walk into our environment, understand it fast, and know exactly how to operate from your own experience. We'll give you a clear SOP, but we're not looking for someone we have to hand-hold or explain the basics to. You'll run this function independently keeping our payment processors healthy without the store manager or backend manager having to chase you. If you need constant direction, this isn't the role. If you want to take real ownership and help us scale to big numbers, keep reading.



What you'll do:



Own and drive down our dispute/chargeback rate across Shopify Payments, PayPal, Klarna, and Whop

Respond to and win disputes, chargebacks, and pre-arbitration cases with strong, evidence-backed submissions

Spot patterns early and put systems in place to prevent disputes before they happen

Work closely with our customer support and backend teams to protect our payment processors and keep them healthy

Report on dispute KPIs and continuously improve win rates



What we're looking for:



3+ years of hands-on experience as a dispute manager in ecommerce — specifically dropshipping stores (this is a must)

Deep, proven experience handling disputes on PayPal and Klarna ( WHOPhop a big plus)

A track record of actually lowering dispute and chargeback rates — not just submitting forms

Someone who takes full ownership of their role and thrives without micromanagement

Strong written English and sharp attention to detail

Reliable, self-driven, and able to work independently within a team



What we offer:



A spot on a fast-growing, multi-market team where you can genuinely grow into higher positions

KPI-based bonuses on top of your base pay — the better your results, the more you earn

Flexibility — work around your schedule

A long-term project, not a one-off gig — this role becomes full-time in Q4



Hours & commitment:



5 days a week, ~4 hours/day on average (flexes between 2–4 hours on lighter days and up to 6-8 hours on busy ones, depending on workload)

We need someone who can start right away



If you know how to keep payment processors healthy, take ownership, and turn disputes into wins, we want to talk.



To apply: Start your proposal with the word "DISPUTE-PRO" and tell us, in one or two sentences, a specific example of a dispute/chargeback rate you brought down — and how. Bonus points if you tell us how you'd take ownership of a function like this without needing to be managed.

title: International Business Development Agent — Poland / CEE Market Entry Support
description:
International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative



Client Acquisition for Warehouse, Fulfillment & Operational Facility in Poland



We are looking for an experienced International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative to help us acquire a foreign client or business partner for our operational facility near Warsaw, Poland.



This is not a standard Virtual Assistant role.



We are not looking for someone who only sends
s, fills in spreadsheets, or passes us empty leads. We need someone who can actively contact companies, make phone calls, speak with decision-makers, ask the right questions, understand business needs, and deliver qualified opportunities for advanced business discussions.



?



About the Project



We have an operational facility in Marki, near Warsaw, Poland, which can be used as:



* warehouse space,

* fulfillment point,

* packing / labeling area,

* light assembly or simple production space,

* local operational base,

* distribution support hub for Poland and Central/Eastern Europe,

* local partner location for a foreign company entering the Polish / EU market.



The facility includes:



* approx. 500 m² hall space with staff / social area,

* approx. 300 m² covered warehouse shelters,

* approx. 2,500 m² yard / land area,

* paved and monitored area,

* maneuvering yard,

* possibility to adapt the cooperation model to the client’s needs,

* possibility to organize staff and operational support.



We are looking for foreign companies that may need a flexible local partner in Poland / CEE instead of immediately setting up their own company, warehouse, team, and local structure.



?



Target Companies



We are especially interested in companies that:



* do not yet have a strong operational structure in Poland or the EU,

* want to enter Poland, Central/Eastern Europe, or the EU market,

* have logistics, customs, warehousing, fulfillment, or distribution problems,

* need a smaller and more flexible alternative to large 3PL providers,

* sell premium, specialized, technical, medical, cosmetic, industrial, or B2B products,

* may benefit from local warehousing, fulfillment, labeling, packing, distribution support, operational coordination, or market entry support.



Interesting markets include:



* United Kingdom,

* USA,

* Canada,

* Australia,

* Singapore,

* UAE,

* India,

* Asia,

* other non-Polish / non-EU international markets.



We do not want to focus only on one country. We are looking for companies for which Poland can solve a real supply chain, distribution, European market entry, or warehousing problem.



?



What We Already Have



You will not start from zero.



We already have:



* initial database of potential companies,

* target industries and markets,

* company
 address,

* Apollo account for contact verification,

* CloudTalk / calling tool,

* outreach tracker,

* first tested outreach messages,

* call script framework,

* clear business objective.



We need someone who can take this process and turn it into real business conversations.



?



Your Main Responsibility



Your task is to actively acquire a real business opportunity.



You will be expected to:



* contact companies by phone,
, and LinkedIn,

* identify the right decision-makers,

* speak with people responsible for logistics, operations, distribution, expansion, procurement, or partnerships,

* understand the company’s current situation,

* ask about operational problems, market entry plans, volume, budget level, and decision process,

* qualify whether the company is a real fit,

* prepare a complete lead profile before handing it over to us.



We do not want “empty leads” such as only a company name or generic
 address.



A qualified opportunity should include:



* company name and website,

* country and industry,

* contact person and position,

* confirmation that the person is relevant,

* current activity in Europe / Poland / CEE,

* current logistics, warehouse, distributor, 3PL, or partner setup,

* operational problem or business need,

* expected support needed,

* possible volume or scale,

* possible timeline,

* budget level or cost expectations if discussed,

* decision-maker information,

* recommendation for next step.



Only after this information is collected can our team prepare a serious business proposal.



?



Requirements



We are looking for someone with real experience in:



* B2B sales,

* cold calling,

* international outreach,

* appointment setting,

* business development,

* lead qualification,

* speaking with decision-makers,

* working toward a concrete business result.



You must be comfortable making business phone calls in English.



Experience in logistics, warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, export/import, e-commerce, manufacturing, medical devices, industrial products, or market entry will be a strong advantage.



?



Compensation



This role is based on a low base rate + high success fee model.



Trial Period



* Trial period: 7–10 days

* Trial rate: 3 USD/hour

* Goal: verify your ability to make calls, qualify prospects, collect useful business information, and report clearly.



Success Fee



We are ready to pay a strong success fee for real results.



Success fee starts from 2,000 USD and may be higher, depending on:



* the type of client,

* the value of the cooperation,

* whether the client starts with a small pilot or larger operation,

* whether the client uses part of the facility or the full location,

* expected monthly cooperation value,

* long-term potential of the relationship.



The success fee is paid for a real business result — a company genuinely acquired through your work that enters into actual cooperation with us.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who trusts their B2B sales skills and wants to earn mainly from results, not only from hours.



?



Long-Term Opportunity



If the acquired company d
 to cooperate with us, this does not have to be the end of your role.



You may continue as our:



* international communication coordinator,

* account manager,

* business development representative,

* foreign partner communication representative.



Your role could include maintaining communication with the foreign partner and supporting the ongoing cooperation.



?



Important



We have limited time to secure a foreign partner for this location.



If we do not find the right foreign company, the facility may be rented to a local Polish business. In that case, this international sales role may no longer be needed in the same scope.



We need someone who can take this seriously, act quickly, and focus on real client acquisition.



?



How to Apply



Please answer the questions below in your application:



1. What is your experience in B2B sales and cold calling?

2. Have you acquired foreign clients by phone before?

3. What industries have you worked with?

4. Do you have experience with logistics, warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, export/import, e-commerce, manufacturing, or market entry?

5. How many business phone calls can you realistically make per day?

6. How do you qualify a cold prospect before handing it over to a client?

7. How do you ask about needs, budget, volume, timeline, and decision-maker?

8. What sales tools have you used?

9. How many hours per week can you realistically dedicate to this project?

10. Are you comfortable with a 3 USD/hour trial period and a high success fee for real results?

11. What success fee would you expect for a genuinely acquired client?

12. Write a short example of a first
 to a UK or US company that may need a flexible operational base in Poland.

13. Write a short first-call script for such a company.



Generic applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can say:



“Give me the database, tools, and clear goal, and I will call, find the right people, qualify the opportunity, collect the information, and move the company toward serious business conversations.”



If this describes you, we would like to hear from you.

~ Strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. This is non-negotiable, you live in these every day.

~ Comfortable in Canva too, especially for the RSVP websites and quick-turnaround pieces.

~ A genuinely good eye for layout and type. You notice when something's off.

~ You get aesthetic direction quickly. My studio has a specific look, and you don't need to design in that style yourself, but you do need to see it and stay true to it when you adapt my work!

~ Fast and reliable with communication. I hate chasing people, and you need to speak and write English well.

~ You follow direction well, but you're not a robot. You'll flag it if something looks wrong!

~ Clean, organised file habits.

~ You're open to collaboration and communication. I'm always up for ideas and suggestions on the design work, so I want someone who'll actually engage!



TO APPLY, SEND ME:



1. Your portfolio! A link please, not attachments.

2. In a line or two, tell me what kind of design work you most enjoy and why. I'd love to get a feel for you.

3. Start your message with the word "xplique" so I know you actually read this. I'll be deleting any that don't, sorry!



If you've read this far and it sounds like you, get in touch! I'm genuinely looking for my right-hand person, and if we work out, this becomes long-term and full-time. I'd love to build the studio out with the right someone.

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing) [Singapore Company]
description:
Creative Strategist — KYOR (Performance Creative)



1) About Us



Symple Wellness created KYOR, a science-backed wellness brand focused on clean formulations, clinically studied ingredients, and real results.



Our hero product line is designed to simplify skincare and boost whole-body wellness — empowering individuals to glow confidently from the inside out.



Website: kyor.co/



We are rapidly expanding, especially in the US market, and we're looking for a sharp, analytical, performance-driven **Creative Strategist** who lives and breathes paid social. This is the person who d
 *what* we say, *who* we say it to, and *why* it'll convert — then writes the briefs that turn that thinking into ads our designers and editors can build.



You won't be pushing pixels in Photoshop all day. Your output is the strategy and the brief: the angle, the persona, the hook, the concept, the shotlist. The visuals follow your thinking. This is one of the highest-leverage roles on the team — get the brief right and everything downstream scales; get it wrong and we burn spend on beautiful ads that don't sell.



2) What You'll Do



- Write 20+ creative briefs per week that translate strategy into clear, buildable direction for designers and video editors across Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories), TikTok, and other platforms

- Develop distinct messaging angles mapped to specific personas, pain points, and awareness stages — not "glow from within" mush, but sharp, differentiated concepts that filter for the right buyer

- Research relentlessly: tear down competitor ads, build and maintain swipe files, study what's winning in beauty/wellness feeds, and reverse-engineer *why* it works

- Define hooks, concepts, and formats for each brief — including the first 3 seconds, the scroll-stopper, and the CTA

- Write UGC scripts, listicle scripts, and shotlists when a brief needs them, and spec AI image/video prompts clearly enough that a designer can execute without guessing

- Partner with designers, copywriters, and our influencer/KOL team to ideate and pressure-test concepts before they go into production

- Read the data and let it drive the next brief: hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS, thumbstop. Kill what's losing, double down on what's winning, and brief accordingly

- Build and extend the frameworks, templates, and naming conventions that let the team move fast and stay organised



 3) What You Bring



**Must-haves**



- 2+ year working on paid social creative — as a strategist, brief-writer, media buyer who briefs creative, UGC strategist, agency creative, or a strong self-directed track record (your own ads, teardowns, or a brand you've run creative for all count)

- Strategic thinking with an actual framework — you reach for persona ? pain ? angle ? hook ? format, not vibes. When you watch an ad you can say *precisely* why it works or doesn't

- Strong, clear writing. A brief is only useful if a designer can build from it without a meeting. You write tight, specific, and unambiguous

- Working understanding of how paid social performs: what hook rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS mean, and how creative moves them

- The ability to generate volume, not just curate. Performance creative is a numbers game — you can produce 15 hooks fast, then know which 3 are worth shooting

- Comfort taking direct, critical feedback and iterating without ego. The job is briefing creative against data feedback every single week, often when the data says your favourite concept flopped. You revise, you don't sulk

- Hungry to learn, genuinely curious about why people buy, and energised by the idea that your work is measured by performance, not praise



 4) AI Proficiency (required)



We expect everyone on this team to use AI to think faster, research deeper, and produce more. You should already be comfortable with — or eager to learn — the tools we use day to day:



- **Ideation, research & brief-writing:** ChatGPT, Claude, or similar — for brainstorming angles, structuring briefs, analysing reviews and competitor ads, and pressure-testing concepts

- **Prompt engineering for production:** you can write image/video prompts precise enough for a designer to run through Nano Banana (Google Gemini's image model), ChatGPT Images, Seedance 2.0, or Veo 3 and get usable output

- **Workflow:** you use AI to compress research and first drafts so you spend your time on the thinking that matters, not the busywork



In the interview process, you'll be asked to show how AI actually shows up in your workflow — not that you've tried these tools, but how you've integrated them into how you strategise and write. If you haven't used our exact stack, that's fine — you should have hands-on experience with comparable tools and be ready to pick ours up quickly.



**Nice-to-haves**



- Personal interest in beauty, wellness, or skincare (you're a KYOR target customer or close to one)

- Familiarity with supplement/beauty compliance — claim substantiation, on-label mechanism language, the difference between a sellable claim and a liability

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager, creative testing, or structured ad scorecards

- Hands-on UGC and influencer/KOL experience — scripting, shotlists, working with creators

- An eye for art direction — you can't make the ad, but you know what good looks like and can point a designer toward it



## 5) How to Apply



Send the following to 
 with the subject line: "I Am Your Creative Strategist — [Your Name]"



- Your CV

- A link to your work — a portfolio, swipe deck, ad teardown thread, briefs you've written, ads you've strategised, or a brand you've run creative for (Behance, Notion, Google Drive, PDF, or social all fine)

- A 3–5 sentence note on which AI tools you currently use in your strategy/research workflow and how



We respond to every application within 5 working days. Shortlisted candidates will go through a short three-round process: a 15-minute personality profiling assessment, followed by 2 strategy tests to understand how you think.

title: Credentialing Specialist/Front Desk Support
description:
Medical Credentialing Specialist

Credentialing / Provider Services

Reports To:  CEO

Employment Type:  Full-Time

Location:  Remote



Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Credentialing Specialist to own and lead the credentialing function for our practice with minimal day-to-day supervision. This person will manage the full credentialing and payer enrollment lifecycle for all providers, partner closely with the billing team to keep providers compliant and in-network, and serve as the subject-matter expert the rest of the team relies on.

In addition to leading credentialing, this role supports our front desk operations. The specialist will answer phones and schedule patient appointments when calls roll over from the front desk, and will step in to support other front-desk functions as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable balancing detailed compliance work with patient-facing support.

Key Responsibilities

Credentialing & Provider Enrollment (Primary)

• Take charge of the practice's credentialing operations independently, managing the complete lifecycle for all providers from initial credentialing through re-credentialing.

• Complete and submit initial credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment applications for commercial and government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans).

• Maintain and update provider profiles in CAQH ProView, PECOS, NPPES/NPI, and payer portals, ensuring all information is accurate and current.

• Perform primary source verification of licenses, education, training, board certifications, work history, and malpractice coverage.

• Track and proactively manage expirables — state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and other time-sensitive credentials — and renew them ahead of deadlines to prevent lapses.

• Maintain organized, audit-ready provider files and credentialing records in compliance with applicable standards (e.g., NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and payer requirements).

• Monitor application status, follow up persistently with payers, and resolve issues to keep enrollment moving and minimize delays.

• Serve as the internal point of contact and resource on credentialing questions, escalations, and process improvements.





Billing & Compliance Collaboration

• Work closely with the billing team to ensure providers remain in compliance with all credentialing and enrollment requirements so that claims can be submitted and reimbursed without disruption.

• Communicate provider effective dates, network participation status, and enrollment changes to billing in a timely manner.

• Help research and resolve claim denials or holds tied to credentialing or enrollment issues.

• Keep leadership and billing informed of upcoming renewals, compliance risks, and any gaps that could affect reimbursement.

Front Desk & Patient Support (Secondary)

• Answer incoming phone calls that roll over from the front desk, providing courteous and professional service to patients.

• Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments accurately.

• Support additional front-desk functions as needed, such as patient check-in/check-out, verifying demographic and insurance information, and responding to general patient inquiries.

• Provide coverage and backup for front-desk staff during high-volume periods, breaks, or absences.

Required Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on medical credentialing and/or payer enrollment experience.

• Demonstrated ability to manage credentialing operations independently with minimal supervision.

• Working knowledge of credentialing standards and regulatory requirements (NCQA, CMS, Joint Commission, and payer-specific guidelines).

• Proficiency with CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, and commercial/government payer enrollment portals.

• Strong understanding of how credentialing and enrollment affect billing and reimbursement.

• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to track many deadlines simultaneously.

• Professional verbal and written communication skills and a patient-friendly phone manner.

• Comfortable using practice management and/or credentialing software, EHR systems, and standard office applications.

• High level of discretion and the ability to handle confidential provider and patient information in compliance with HIPAA.

Preferred Qualifications

• CPCS (Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist) or CPMSM (Certified Professional Medical Services Management) certification through NAMSS or equivalent experience.

• Prior experience in a lead or senior credentialing role.

• Front desk, scheduling, or patient-facing healthcare experience.

• Familiarity with the specialties and payers relevant to our practice.

Core Competencies

• Ownership & autonomy — takes initiative and drives the credentialing function forward without needing close oversight.

• Detail & accuracy — treats deadlines and documentation as non-negotiable.

• Collaboration — works seamlessly across credentialing, billing, and front-desk teams.

• Adaptability — moves comfortably between focused compliance work and patient-facing support.

• Customer service — represents the practice professionally to patients and payers alike.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

• Standard medical office environment.

• Extended periods of computer and phone work.

• Occasional reaching, lifting of office materials, and movement throughout the office to support front-desk coverage.

title: AutoCAD Drafter – Industrial / Warehouse / Racking / Construction Projects
description:
Role Overview



The 3D Automation Designer will be responsible for creating detailed 2D and 3D layouts for warehouse automation and material handling systems.



This role will support sales, engineering, estimating, project management, and installation teams by turning customer requirements, site layouts, equipment drawings, and automation concepts into clear, buildable designs.



The ideal candidate has experience with MHE systems, warehouse layouts, conveyor design, automation equipment, and 3D modeling software. This person should understand how to design practical systems that can actually be installed in the field.



Key Responsibilities



Create 2D and 3D designs for warehouse automation and material handling systems.



Design layouts for conveyor systems, sortation systems, racking, mezzanines, platforms, pick modules, ASRS, VLMs, shuttles, AMRs/AGVs, and other MHE systems.



Prepare concept layouts, customer presentation drawings, sales support visuals, and project design packages.



Convert customer requirements, building drawings, site measurements, sketches, equipment drawings, and redlines into clean design layouts.



Support sales and estimating teams with early-stage automation concepts and layout options.



Create system layouts that show equipment locations, flow paths, clearances, pick/pack areas, workstations, elevations, platforms, access points, safety zones, and installation considerations.



Coordinate with engineers, project managers, sales teams, vendors, manufacturers, integrators, and site teams.



Review equipment drawings and vendor layouts to identify fit, clearance, access, and installation issues.



Assist with developing layouts that improve product flow, labour efficiency, space utilization, safety, and system performance.



Prepare drawings for customer review, estimating, engineering review, permitting support, fabrication coordination, installation, and as-built records.



Support field teams with drawing revisions, design clarifications, and site-condition updates.



Maintain proper file organization, drawing version control, and revision tracking.



Help develop MTLI standard drawing templates, automation layout standards, and 3D presentation formats.



Required Experience



3+ years of experience in 2D/3D design, automation design, MHE design, warehouse layout design, or industrial systems design.



Experience designing or drafting conveyor systems, sortation systems, warehouse automation, racking, mezzanines, platforms, or material handling layouts.



Strong experience with AutoCAD and at least one 3D design/modeling platform.



Ability to read and understand architectural drawings, structural drawings, warehouse layouts, equipment drawings, and MHE system drawings.



Ability to create clear plan views, elevations, sections, details, 3D views, and presentation layouts.



Strong understanding of warehouse operations, product flow, clearances, equipment footprints, and installation constraints.



Ability to work from sketches, redlines, PDFs, site photos, measurements, and customer requirements.



Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects at once.



Good communication skills and ability to work with sales, engineering, PMs, vendors, and field teams.



Preferred Experience



Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor, SolidWorks, SketchUp, Navisworks, Plant 3D, Fusion 360, Tekla, or similar design tools.



Experience with conveyor manufacturers, automation integrators, racking companies, warehouse consultants, or industrial contractors.



Experience designing systems for distribution centers, fulfillment centers, manufacturing facilities, e-commerce operations, or 3PL warehouses.



Experience with ASRS, AMRs/AGVs, robotic picking, sortation, pick modules, workstations, pack lines, pallet handling, case handling, and tote handling systems.



Experience creating customer-facing 3D visuals, renderings, walk-throughs, or concept presentations.



Experience coordinating with structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and installation teams.



Experience with permit drawings, fabrication drawings, installation drawings, and as-built drawings is an asset.



Skills We Are Looking For



Strong 2D and 3D design ability.



Strong understanding of warehouse automation and MHE systems.



Ability to create clean, practical, buildable layouts.



Strong spatial awareness and understanding of equipment clearances.



Ability to think through product flow, operator movement, maintenance access, safety, and installation sequencing.



High attention to detail.



Fast turnaround ability.



Strong communication and organization.



Ability to support both sales concepts and project execution drawings.



Ability to turn rough ideas into professional layouts and 3D visuals.



Practical field-first mindset.

title: HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer
description:
HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time Contract

Work Schedule: Must be available to work during Pacific Standard Time business hours

Compensation: $8–$12 per hour USD, depending on experience and skill set



About Set 2 Close



Set 2 Close is a revenue operations and enablement agency that helps businesses optimize their marketing, sales, and customer success systems for predictable growth. We bridge the gap between strategy, technology, and execution by helping clients build better systems, improve workflows, and create scalable digital experiences.



We are looking for a HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer to join our team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong front-end development skills with a sharp eye for user experience and visual design. The right candidate will be comfortable working directly with clients to design, build, and optimize web pages inside HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.

The HubSpot CMS & UX/UI Web Developer will be responsible for creating responsive, user-friendly, and visually polished web pages using HubSpot CMS. This person should be well-versed in HubSpot’s CMS capabilities, including website building, templates, modules, HubDB, integrations, and front-end customization.



This role is primarily focused on HubSpot CMS web design and development, but experience with HubSpot reporting, analytics, pipelines, marketing campaigns, and general HubSpot administration will be valuable.



We are looking for someone who can take client requirements, translate them into strong UX/UI designs, and then build functional, scalable web pages within HubSpot.



* Key Responsibilities

HubSpot CMS Web Design & Development

Design, build, and maintain responsive web pages using HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.

Develop and customize HubSpot templates, themes, modules, landing pages, and website pages.

Use HTML, CSS, HubL, and basic JavaScript to create clean, scalable, and functional front-end experiences.

Build modular page designs that are easy for clients and internal teams to update.

Work with HubDB to create dynamic content and database-driven web pages.

Support the setup and customization of HubSpot CMS assets, including forms, CTAs, menus, blog templates, and global content.

Ensure websites and landing pages are optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences.



* UX/UI Design

Translate client brand guidelines, marketing goals, and business requirements into strong web experiences.

Apply UX/UI best practices to improve usability, navigation, page flow, and conversion performance.

Design wireframes, mockups, or page layouts when needed before development.

Balance design aesthetics with practical, functional, and scalable implementation inside HubSpot.



* Client-Facing Collaboration

Work directly with clients to understand their website needs, page requirements, branding, and desired user experience.

Communicate technical and design decisions clearly to both clients and internal teams.

Collaborate with marketing strategists, RevOps specialists, developers, and project managers to deliver high-quality HubSpot CMS projects.

Gather feedback, make revisions, and ensure final web pages align with client expectations.



* HubSpot Marketing & CRM Support

Assist with building and supporting HubSpot marketing campaigns.

Help create and optimize landing pages, forms, workflows,
 assets, and campaign-related web pages.

Support basic HubSpot reporting and analytics setup.

Assist with HubSpot pipeline setup, basic CRM configuration, and marketing/sales process support when needed.

Use HubSpot reporting tools to help clients understand website performance, campaign results, and conversion activity.



* Testing, Optimization & Maintenance

Test pages across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

Troubleshoot layout, styling, responsiveness, and CMS-related issues.

Optimize pages for speed, SEO, accessibility, and conversion best practices.

Maintain clean, organized, and reusable front-end code.

Identify opportunities to improve existing HubSpot CMS pages, templates, and user experiences.



* Required Skills & Qualifications

Proven experience designing and developing websites inside HubSpot CMS / Content Hub.

Strong front-end development skills, especially in HTML, CSS, and HubL.

Working knowledge of JavaScript is preferred.

Strong understanding of UX/UI design principles.

Experience building responsive websites and landing pages.

Experience working with HubSpot templates, modules, themes, and CMS page editing tools.

Familiarity with HubDB and dynamic content inside HubSpot.

Ability to build visually appealing designs and translate them into functional web pages.

Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with clients.

Ability to collaborate with marketing, sales, and technical teams.

Understanding of SEO, accessibility, website speed, and conversion best practices.

Ability to work during Pacific Standard Time business hours.

A portfolio showcasing HubSpot CMS, UX/UI, web design, or front-end development work is required.



* Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with HubSpot Content Hub Remix.

Experience creating custom HubSpot themes and reusable modules.

Experience with HubSpot marketing tools,
 campaigns, workflows, forms, and CTAs.

Experience setting up HubSpot dashboards, reports, and basic analytics.

Experience building or supporting HubSpot pipelines.

Basic understanding of RevOps, CRM systems, lead generation, and marketing automation.

Experience using design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Canva, or similar platforms.

Experience working in an agency or client-facing environment.



* Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a hybrid designer and developer who understands both how a website should look and how it should function. You are creative, detail-oriented, and technically capable. You can work with a client to understand their vision, design a strong user experience, and build it inside HubSpot CMS.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of HubSpot CMS projects, from page layout and UX/UI design to front-end implementation and troubleshooting. You enjoy creating web pages that are not only visually strong but also functional, responsive, and easy to manage.



This role is best suited for someone who can communicate clearly, work independently, collaborate with internal teams, and deliver high-quality HubSpot CMS experiences for clients.

Remote work setup.

Opportunity to work with a fast-growing revenue operations and enablement agency.

title: Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads (Remote)
description:
Graphic Designer — Direct Response Static Ads (Remote )

We're a fast-moving direct response health & wellness brand scaling aggressively on paid social (Meta FB ads. We need a graphic designer who already knows what a winning static ad looks like in the DR world — not someone we have to teach.

What you'll be doing:



Creating high-converting static image ads across the entire funnel. That means top-of-funnel native-style creatives designed to blend into the feed and stop the scroll, mid-funnel ads that retarget warm audiences with social proof, testimonials, comparison graphics, and "why us" positioning, and bottom-of-funnel ads that close — urgency-driven creatives, offer stacks, limited-time reminders, and conversion-focused layouts that push people over the edge.



You'll also be working on advertorial-style layouts, before/afters, UGC-style statics, editorial mockups, and review/testimonial highlight creatives. Everything is built to sell, not to look pretty on a mood board.



You need to have:

Experience designing statics specifically for direct response brands — health, beauty, skincare, supplement, or wellness brands that run paid traffic at scale. If your portfolio is full of corporate branding or logo work, this isn't the right fit. We want to see ads that were built to convert at every stage of the funnel.

Proficiency in Figma, Photoshop, and/or Canva Pro. You know how to work with ad dimensions across platforms, understand text-safe zones, and can format for mobile-first.

A strong grasp of what makes people stop scrolling at TOF, what builds trust and desire at MOF, and what triggers action at BOF. You understand visual hierarchy, bold hooks, curiosity-driven layouts, and how to pair copy with imagery so the whole thing hits as one unit.



What we expect:

You can hit 24-hour turnaround deadlines consistently. When we send you a brief in the morning, we need deliverables by the next day — not "sometime this week."

You can handle revisions fast. First round of feedback shouldn't take another full day. We move quickly and need someone who matches our speed.

You're comfortable receiving direct, blunt creative feedback. We test everything and iterate based on data, not feelings.

You can manage multiple briefs at once without dropping the ball.

Bonus if you:

Have experience creating statics that pair with video ad funnels — pre-sell pages, advertorials, landing page headers. Understand the relationship between the ad creative, the hook, and the landing page experience. Have worked with supplement, skincare, or anti-aging brands specifically.

To apply:

Send your portfolio with examples of direct response statics you've designed across TOF, MOF, and BOF (not brand work — actual DR ad creatives). Tell us which brands you've worked with, what platforms those ads ran on, and if possible, share any performance context. If you don't have DR-specific work to show, this role probably isn't the right match.

title: Video Editor & Motion Designer (Paid Social) - Muscle Nation
description:
We’re looking for a mid-level Video Editor & Motion Designer to join Muscle Nation’s creative team and help produce high-performing paid social content. This role is equal parts editing and motion design where you’ll cut raw footage into conversion-focused video ads AND build polished motion assets including supers, lower thirds, animated transitions, and kinetic typography.



If you understand how paid media ads are structured, know what makes someone stop scrolling in the first 3 seconds, and can execute both live-action edits and motion graphics at a high level - we want to hear from you!



About the Role



You’ll work across
, Instagram, and TikTok ad campaigns, collaborating closely with our Creative Strategist, Paid Media Manager, and videographers. You’re not just assembling clips - you’re building ads with a clear understanding of direct-response structure: hook, body, CTA. You know how to re-hook viewers throughout a piece using pacing shifts, visual pattern interrupts and motion elements that maintain attention.



Your Day-to-Day



- Edit video content for paid social campaigns across Meta and TikTok, working with existing footage and assets stored in Google Drive

- Create 3+ variations per concept for testing - different hooks, pacing, CTAs and visual treatments to maximise performance

- Design and build motion assets: animated supers, lower thirds, text overlays, transitions, kinetic typography, and branded end cards

- Craft scroll-stopping hooks in the first 1–3 seconds using a combination of editing technique and motion design

- Apply re-hook techniques throughout each ad - pacing changes, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, and motion cues that sustain viewer attention

- Adapt content across platform-specific formats and aspect ratios (9:16 Stories/Reels, 4:5 Feed, 1:1 where needed)

- Collaborate with the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager to interpret briefs, understand performance data, and iterate on creative direction

- Coordinate with videographers to understand available footage and plan asset requirements

- Test new creative approaches and editing styles while maintaining brand consistency

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously with quick turnaround times

- Stay current with paid social trends, platform algorithm changes, and emerging ad formats



What We’re Looking For



- 2-4 years of video editing experience with a focus on social media advertising or performance creative

- Strong motion graphics and animation skills - you can build supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, and branded elements from scratch in After Effects (or equivalent)

- Proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar) plus experience with After Effects or a comparable motion design tool

- Experience with AI-driven editing and design platforms

- Deep understanding of paid ad structure - you know how hooks, body content, and CTAs work together to drive conversions

- Strong design eye - you understand typography, layout, colour, and hierarchy, and can apply these principles to motion assets that look polished and on-brand

- Knowledge of platform-specific video formats, specs, and best practices across Meta and TikTok

- Experience creating multiple creative variations for testing and optimisation

- Ability to work with feedback efficiently, managing multiple projects with tight deadlines

- Excellent communication skills for collaborating with creative and paid media teams across time zones



Bonus Points



- Experience with fitness, wellness, or supplement brands

- Understanding of paid social advertising metrics (CTR, hook rate, hold rate, thumbstop ratio, ROAS)

- Experience editing UGC-style content for direct-response campaigns

- Familiarity with creative testing frameworks and iteration processes

- Background working with e-commerce brands or performance marketing agencies

- Familiarity with the Australian market and cultural nuances



Work Arrangement



- 30-day contract with a view to transition into a full-time role based on performance and mutual fit

- Based in the Philippines, working remotely with our Australian team

- Flexible schedule with regular meetings alongside AU creative and paid media teams

- Reporting to the Creative Strategist and Paid Media Manager



How to Apply



Please note: we will only progress applications that complete the task below.



Video Editing & Motion Design Task



Objective:



Promote our Protein Water to fitness enthusiasts aged 22–35 through engaging short-form paid social content.



Brief:



You’ve been provided with raw footage here. Your task is to create 3x short-form video ads (15–30 seconds each), each with a different hook and creative approach, suitable for
 and Instagram Feed/Stories.



You can use placeholder footage or describe your editing approach where needed.



Available Assets:

UGC-style fitness creator footage (gym setting, protein shaker)

Pouring clips

Workout clips

Product pack shots

Backdrop footage



What We Want to See:



- A strong, scroll-stopping hook within the first 3 seconds of each variation - show us you understand what makes someone stop and watch

- Re-hook techniques throughout each ad that sustain viewer attention (pacing shifts, visual pattern interrupts, text callouts, motion cues)

- Motion design elements you’ve built: supers, lower thirds, animated text, transitions, or branded end cards - these should demonstrate your design ability, not just your editing chops

- Understanding of paid ad structure: hook > body > CTA

- Platform-appropriate formatting in both 9:16 and 4:5 aspect ratios



Submission Requirements:

- 3x video ad variations as described above

- Your portfolio showcasing relevant paid social video and motion design work

- A brief cover letter explaining your experience with performance creative and motion design, and why this role excites you



Evaluation Criteria:



- Hook effectiveness - does it stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds?

- Re-hook and pacing techniques - how well do you sustain attention throughout the ad?

- Motion design quality - are your supers, text treatments, and transitions polished and well-designed?

- Understanding of paid ad structure and platform best practices

- Creative storytelling and performance marketing mindset

- Technical editing skills and attention to detail



We’re excited to see how you can help elevate our paid social creative and drive results for Muscle Nation!

description:
We're a US-based fertilizer and soil mix company selling on Amazon and other e-commerce platforms. We're hiring Amazon listing specialists.



THE ROLE

We use an in-house app that handles product research, keyword selection, and listing copy. It outputs a ready Amazon flat file. Your job is the human layer on top of it:



1. Run the app and generate the flat file for each product.

2. Review the flat file carefully. Check the listing copy, titles, bullets, and backend fields for errors, typos, awkward English, and anything that doesn't fit a US retail audience.

3. Create the listing images: a clean main image (pure white background, RGB 255/255/255), lifestyle images, infographics (NPK, coverage, application), and A+ Content. You can use AI image tools to generate base assets, then refine them to a professional, sales-ready standard.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong, fluent written English. You must be able to catch copy errors, not just design.

- Solid Photoshop skills, comfortable refining AI-generated images into polished visuals.

- Familiarity with Amazon listings, image standards, and A+ Content.

- Detail-oriented, reliable, and able to follow instructions precisely.

- Experience in the lawn/garden/fertilizer niche is a plus, not required.



IMPORTANT

This is a regulated product category. Any text or claims placed on images must be approved by us first. Accuracy matters more than creative freedom on wording. Do not add performance claims (e.g., "cures," "best," "guarantees").



TO APPLY, READ CAREFULLY

Applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored:

1. Start your reply with the word "GREEN" so we know you read the full post.

2. Send your portfolio link (Amazon listings / A+ content preferred).

3. List the design and AI tools you use.

4. Tell us your fastest reliable turnaround for one full listing image set (main + 3 supporting + 1 A+ module).

title: Customer Service Respresentative
description:
We’re looking for a Customer Service Representative who will take full responsibility for handling customer inquiries, exchanges, and returns for our E-commerce fashion dropshipping stores.

You’ll be part of a dedicated customer service team, working closely with other representatives and a manager to ensure that as much revenue as possible is driven and retained through customer service.



We’re not looking for someone who just “replies to emails.” We’re looking for someone who thinks and acts like an A-player: disciplined, proactive, and committed to excellence.

You communicate with empathy, and take ownership of every situation. You always look for solutions instead of excuses and understand that every interaction is a chance to create value for both the customer and the company.



You must already have experience in customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and know how to communicate effectively, handle returns and exchanges, and solve problems efficiently, keeping customers happy while protecting company profits.

You should know how to use Shopify and ParcelPanel, maintain a professional and calm tone under pressure, and be able to work according to the New York (US) timezone, since most of our customer interactions follow that schedule.

Experience with return funnels and ChatGPT for communication improvement is a must.



You’ll handle emails, refunds, replacements, and order inquiries together with other team members, ensuring a fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer experience every day.

We value people who are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented, who identify problems before they escalate, and who constantly aim to improve how things are done.



You understand that great customer service doesn’t just solve issues. It drives revenue and keeps profits within the company.



This is a position for someone who takes pride in delivering world-class service and wants to be part of a high-performing, professional team.



Please answer these questions in your application:

1. What is your experience with customer service for Shopify fashion dropshipping stores, and for how long?

2. Have you worked for other fashion dropshipping stores before? If yes, which ones?

3. What are your main strengths, and how can you make the company better? What knowledge or ideas can you bring?

4. Are you familiar with Shopify, Zendesk, ParcelPanel, and ChatGPT?

5. Do you have experience with return funnels?

6. Do you speak and write English fluently?

7. Are you currently working for another company?

8. How many hours and days per week are you available? Are you also available during weekends?

9. Can you work according to the New York (US) timezone?

10. Do you always have a stable Wi-Fi connection?

11. What is your desired monthly compensation?

12. What’s your favorite dish?



Please include your phone number in the application so we can contact you directly through Whatsapp!

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Description



We are hiring a Business Development Manager to own and manage the majority of our digital business. This role is ideal for someone with a strong small business background who is comfortable managing day-to-day operations and stepping into the details when needed.

This is a hands-on role. We are not looking for a high-level executive who operates far from execution. We are looking for someone who can manage and do.



Responsibilities

• Platform Ownership: Owning the end-to-end e-commerce operation across Amazon as the primary platform.  

• Vendor & Agency Management: Acting as the main point of contact for agencies and third-party vendors, including managing vendor contacts and leading negotiations.  

• Daily Operations: Overseeing technical, operational, and day-to-day e-commerce activities, including product additions, integrations, and customer service escalations.  

• Cross-Functional Coordination: Representing the company on technical, operational, and integration-related calls, and coordinating with in-person staff regarding e-commerce operations.  

• Stakeholder Communication: Communicating clearly with company owners on progress, issues, and priorities.  Problem Solving: Getting hands-on when needed to resolve technical or operational issues and unblock operations.



Platforms and Experience Required

• Experience with Amazon is strongly preferred. 

• Exposure to Walmart or eBay is a plus but not required.  

• Comfort managing integrations, apps, and technical workflows.  

• Proven experience working with agencies, external partners, and managing vendor negotiations.



Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, E-commerce, or a related field is preferred.  

• Experience managing or supporting marketplace platforms such as Amazon, Etsy, eBay, etc.  

• Background working in product-based or multi-channel e-commerce businesses.  

• Operational Skills

• Strong understanding of end-to-end e-commerce operations, workflows, and vendor relationship management.  

• Able to manage day-to-day execution and priorities independently.  

• Comfortable working remotely and independently with minimal supervision.  

• Ability to work fully during Central Standard Time (CST) business hours.  

Nice to Have Skills

• Experience with additional third-party marketplace platforms. 

• Familiarity with e-commerce integrations, apps, and third-party tools. 

• Exposure to international e-commerce operations or cross-border selling.  

• Comfortable supporting or overseeing digital marketing initiatives in partnership with specialists or agencies.  

• Experience helping scale or integrate new brands or acquisitions into an existing e-commerce platform.



Ideal Candidate Profile

• Comes from a small business or growing company environment.  

• Is comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating without being “too high level”.  

• Is not afraid to get into the operational, technical, or negotiation details.  

• Can grow with the company as we scale and potentially acquire other businesses. 



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.

title: AI Forward Bookkeeper
description:

We are looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper who doesn't just do things "the old way." You will be responsible for managing our core financial records, but with a significant twist: you should be comfortable leveraging AI tools and database matching to streamline our reconciliations and reporting.

If you are a QuickBooks expert who loves finding ways to automate manual workflows, we want to talk to you.



Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Bookkeeping: Perform regular bank and credit card reconciliations with 100?curacy.

QuickBooks Management: Post entries, manage accounts payable/receivable, and ensure the general ledger is audit-ready.

AI Integration: Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, specialized accounting AI, or automated OCR) to categorize transactions and summarize financial data.

Database Matching: Use databases or advanced spreadsheet functions to match high-volume transactional data against bank statements.

Process Optimization: Identify manual bottlenecks and implement automated solutions to speed up the monthly close.



Required Skills & Qualifications

QuickBooks Mastery: Deep experience with QuickBooks Online or Desktop.

AI Literacy: Proven ability to use AI tools to increase productivity and data accuracy.

Data Savvy: Strong understanding of how to work with databases (SQL knowledge is a plus) and advanced Excel/Google Sheets.

Reconciliation Expert: You should be able to spot a $0.01 discrepancy in a sea of thousands of lines.

Self-Starter: Since this is an urgent hire, you must be able to hit the ground running with minimal hand-holding.



We offer performance-based increase and HMO, as part of our many perks and benefits.
